description:
A customer brings in a defective computer and the CRS checks the defect and hands out a repair cost calculation back.
If the customer decides that the costs are acceptable, the process continues, otherwise she takes her computer home unrepaired.
The ongoing repair consists of two activities, which are executed, in an arbitrary order.
The first activity is to check and repair the hardware, whereas the second activity checks and configures the software.
After each of these activities, the proper system functionality is tested.
If an error is detected another arbitrary repair activity is executed, otherwise the repair is finished.

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestHardware</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Start" name="Start">

    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_BringIn" name="Bring in defective computer">

    </bpmn:manualTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BringIn_CheckDefect</bpmn:incoming>

    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_HandOutCost" name="Hand out repair cost calculation">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HandOut_CostAcceptance</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CostAcceptance" name="Customer accepts costs?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotAccepted_TakeHome</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_TakeHome" name="Take computer home unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotAccepted_TakeHome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TakeHome_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_TakenHome" name="Computer taken home unrepaired">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TakeHome_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairSplit" name="Split repair activities" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Accepted_RepairSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_RepairHardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_ConfigureSoftware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairHardware" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_RepairHardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairHardware_TestHardware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHardware" name="Test hardware functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairHardware_TestHardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestHardware_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureSoftware" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_ConfigureSoftware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConfigureSoftware_TestSoftware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftware" name="Test software functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ConfigureSoftware_TestSoftware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TestSoftware_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairJoin" name="Join repair activities" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestHardware_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TestSoftware_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_ErrorMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorMerge" name="Merge after test" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_ErrorMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RetryTestHardware_ErrorMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RetryTestSoftware_ErrorMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ErrorMerge_ErrorCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorCheck" name="Error detected?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ErrorMerge_ErrorCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoError_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Error_RetryChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RepairCompleted" name="Repair finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoError_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RetryChoice" name="Select repair activity (arbitrary)" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Error_RetryChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RetryChoice_RepairHardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RetryChoice_ConfigureSoftware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RetryRepairHardware" name="Execute repair activity">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RetryChoice_RepairHardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RetryRepairHardware_TestHardware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RetryTestHardware" name="Test hardware functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RetryRepairHardware_TestHardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RetryTestHardware_ErrorMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RetryConfigureSoftware" name="Execute repair activity">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RetryChoice_ConfigureSoftware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RetryConfigureSoftware_TestSoftware</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RetryTestSoftware" name="Test software functionality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RetryConfigureSoftware_TestSoftware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RetryTestSoftware_ErrorMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_BringIn" sourceRef="StartEvent_Start" targetRef="ManualTask_BringIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BringIn_CheckDefect" sourceRef="ManualTask_BringIn" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckDefect_HandOut" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="ManualTask_HandOutCost"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotAccepted_TakeHome" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CostAcceptance" targetRef="ManualTask_TakeHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TakeHome_End" sourceRef="ManualTask_TakeHome" targetRef="EndEvent_TakenHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accepted_RepairSplit" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CostAcceptance" targetRef="Gateway_RepairSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_RepairHardware" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairHardware_TestHardware" sourceRef="Task_RepairHardware" targetRef="Task_TestHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TestHardware_Join" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_RepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ConfigureSoftware" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairSplit" targetRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfigureSoftware_TestSoftware" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestSoftware"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_ErrorMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorMerge"/>
